items.zh-Hans: 恢复 Intel Mac 支持，提供同时包含 arm64 与 x86_64 的通用安装包；主应用、小组件和更新助手均保留两种架构。
items.en: Restore Intel Mac support with a Universal package containing arm64 and x86_64 for the app, widgets and updater helpers.

items.zh-Hans: CLI 与 MCP 使用同一通用可执行文件，无需按芯片选择安装包；继续支持 macOS 14 及更新系统。
items.en: The CLI and MCP share the Universal executable. Use the same download on either chip family, with macOS 14 or later.

items.zh-Hans: 保留 1.17.1 的性能优化、事件数据、列表和小组件设置；应用内更新沿用现有签名更新源。
items.en: Retain the 1.17.1 performance improvements, events, lists and widget settings, using the existing signed in-app update feed.

items.zh-Hans: 优化本地备份列表：缓存已验证内容的事件计数，减少大量事件和备份时的重复解码；仍校验实际文件内容。
items.en: Reduce repeated decoding when listing local backups by caching validated event counts, while continuing to verify actual file contents.

items.zh-Hans: 保存事件时直接编码最终文档，减少重复的 JSON 编码与解码，保留冲突检测、原子写入和 Agent 重试保护。
items.en: Encode the final event document directly when saving, reducing JSON work while retaining conflict checks, atomic writes and Agent retry protection.

items.zh-Hans: 事件撤销历史保留最近 100 次操作，限制长时间使用时完整快照的持续积累；文字编辑的原生撤销保持独立。
items.en: Keep the latest 100 event undo operations to bound retained full-document snapshots during long sessions. Native text-editing undo remains separate.

items.zh-Hans: 修复清理构建产物后，增量构建可能遗漏 Sparkle 更新框架的问题，并增加恢复与路径保护测试。
items.en: Fix incremental builds omitting the Sparkle updater framework after build-product cleanup, with recovery and path-safety tests.

items.zh-Hans: 新增普通列表和可嵌套文件夹，可按工作、生活等分类事件；侧栏“列表”右侧的加号统一创建列表、智能列表和文件夹。
items.en: Organize events in regular lists and nested folders. Use the plus beside Lists to create a list, smart list or folder.

items.zh-Hans: 事件“显示”页新增到期后处理：保留原日期继续计日，或将一次性事件移入可恢复的回收站；保留的纪念事件也可使用周年格式。
items.en: Choose what happens after an event in Display settings: keep the original date and count elapsed days, or move a one-time event to recoverable Trash. Memories can also use anniversary formatting.

items.zh-Hans: 事件日期新增每天、每月重复，与每年重复统一选择；短月使用月末，下个月恢复原日号。通知仍在“提醒”页单独设置。
items.en: Repeat event dates daily or monthly alongside yearly recurrence. Short months use the last day, then restore the original day next month. Configure notifications separately in Reminders.

items.zh-Hans: 今天尚未到期的定时事件，在开启当天计时的小组件中显示“还有 HH:mm”，去掉重复秒计时，目标日期仍可显示。
items.en: With same-day timers enabled, widgets show today’s upcoming timed events as Remaining HH:mm, without a duplicate seconds timer. The target date remains optional.

items.zh-Hans: 到期处理会等待编辑结束；全天事件保留到当天结束，恢复后取消自动清理。App 关闭时组件先隐藏到期事件，下次打开 App 或 CLI 时移入回收站。
items.en: Expiry waits for active edits to finish. All-day events remain until the day ends; restoring an event disables automatic cleanup. Widgets hide expired events while the app is closed; the app or CLI moves them to Trash when next opened.

items.zh-Hans: CLI、JSON 与 MCP 支持 afterDate=keep|trash（CLI：--after-date）；延续重试去重、冲突保护、备份及提醒同步。
items.en: Set afterDate=keep|trash through JSON/MCP, or --after-date in the CLI, with existing deduplication, conflict protection, backups and reminder synchronization.

items.zh-Hans: 重新分组事件基本信息，重复频率和标签各自成组，不再挤在“更多选项”里；CLI/MCP 同步支持 repeatDaily 和 repeatMonthly。
items.en: Separate date recurrence and tags into clear editor groups. CLI/MCP also accept repeatDaily and repeatMonthly.

items.zh-Hans: 修复 MCP 持续监听时，Finder、Spotlight 或正常打开日距无法出现主窗口的问题；已有旧版 MCP 连接需在 Agent 中重新连接。
items.en: Fix normal opening from Finder or Spotlight while an MCP server is listening. Reconnect existing MCP clients to use the new executable.

items.zh-Hans: 提醒不再安排到一次性事件到期之后；旧事件默认保留，既有列表、智能列表、小组件选择和显示设置保持。
items.en: Stop scheduling reminders beyond a one-time event’s expiry. Existing events default to keeping their original dates; preserve lists, smart lists, widget selections and display settings.

items.zh-Hans: 新增 CLI + JSON 与 MCP stdio，可由本机 Agent 创建、查询、修改、归档事件，以及移入回收站或恢复。
items.en: Add a JSON CLI and MCP stdio server for local agents to create, query, edit, archive, trash and restore events.

items.zh-Hans: 设置新增“自动化”，可分别授权读取和写入；支持安装用户级命令行工具，默认不开放事件访问。
items.en: Add Automation settings with separate read/write access and a user-level command installer. Event access is off by default.

items.zh-Hans: App 打开时通过本机私有通信处理命令，退出后可无窗口执行；沿用备份、提醒同步和小组件刷新。
items.en: Route commands through the running app or process them without a window when it is closed, using the existing backup, reminder and widget-refresh paths.

items.zh-Hans: 创建支持 requestId 重试去重，修改支持 revision 冲突检查；编辑中的草稿和文件操作会阻止外部写入。
items.en: Deduplicate create retries using requestId and check revisions before edits. Active drafts and file operations block external mutations.

items.zh-Hans: 确保冷启动打开指定事件后才确认成功；跨时区重试年度事件不会重复创建或错误冲突，初始化故障可明确重试。
items.en: Acknowledge cold-start event opening only after the GUI accepts it; preserve yearly-event retries across time zones and allow recovery from local initialization failures.

items.zh-Hans: 新增“更新日志”，可在设置中离线查看本次变化和历史公开版本。
items.en: Add Release Notes in Settings to read current changes and previous public releases offline.

items.zh-Hans: 更新提示展示本次更新说明，安装前可了解新增功能和修复内容。
items.en: Show release notes in update prompts so you can review new features and fixes before installing.

items.zh-Hans: 首次打开、更新或替换安装包后，自动请求登记日距小组件。
items.en: Request widget registration automatically after installation, an update, or replacing the app.

items.zh-Hans: 设置 → 小组件新增“刷新并修复小组件”，可重试系统登记和内容刷新，无需终端操作。
items.en: Add Refresh & Repair Widgets in Settings to retry registration and content refresh without Terminal.

items.zh-Hans: 保留已有事件和组件配置；修复结果清楚区分请求已提交、安装不完整及系统未响应。
items.en: Preserve events and widget configurations, with distinct messages for submitted requests, incomplete installations, and timeouts.

items.zh-Hans: 大号组件不足一页时从顶部依次排列，底部留白；最后一页和翻页按钮同样保持稳定布局。
items.en: Keep partially filled large-widget pages aligned at the top, including the last page, with paging controls at the bottom.

items.zh-Hans: 改进中英文资源目录的识别，修复部分构建环境中的语言回退。
items.en: Resolve localized resource directories consistently, fixing language fallback in some build environments.

items.zh-Hans: 加入应用内更新，可自动检查 GitHub 新版，也可手动检查；确认后下载、验签、安装并重新打开。
items.en: Add in-app updates with optional automatic checks, manual checks, and confirmed download, verification, installation, and relaunch.

items.zh-Hans: 更新保护未完成的编辑和文件操作；应用及更新组件仅保留 Apple Silicon 架构。
items.en: Protect active edits and file operations during updates; keep the app and updater components Apple Silicon only.

items.zh-Hans: 首次公开开发预览：倒计日与正计日、桌面组件、归档回收站、导入导出、每日和周年提醒。
items.en: First public developer preview: countdowns, elapsed days, desktop widgets, archive and trash, import/export, and daily and anniversary reminders.

items.zh-Hans: 系统允许通知后，返回应用或打开设置会刷新权限状态并补排提醒。
items.en: Refresh notification permission and reschedule reminders when returning to the app or opening Settings after permission is allowed.
